text:
Meridian planning notes (3–10 Nov) cover 26 modules. Latest corrected values: checkout timeout_s 70, pricing timeout_s 120, billing queue_depth 270, media ttl_s 600, archive batch_size 900, ledger max_workers 16, inventory queue_depth 490, shipping timeout_s 30 and ttl_s 450, indexer timeout_s 55.

Hard rules: no dependency path from reports to notify, quota to gateway, or archive to sync; indexer must not depend on auth. Client requires tenant timeout_s 70 and reports retry_limit 8.

Co-locate tenant with checkout, backup with quota, billing with media, inventory with shipping. Separate backup from media, auth from cache, alerts from archive, indexer from shipping.

Ownership: tenant and indexer on alpha; search and webhooks on gamma; profile and reports on delta; billing on beta. Rollout requires gateway before cache.

Budget review moved to next Thursday; on-call rota changes next month; no Rust rewrites this quarter.
